channel.title: The Brussels Times
channel.description: Latest posts from The Brussels Times.

item.title: WHO hopeful as multiple Ebola drugs trials get underway
item.description: Promising early results from trials of Ebola medicines and vaccines offer hope in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

item.title: Oil prices rise as Trump gives Iran 'last chance' to find agreement
item.description: The US president said that negotiations with Iran had taken place – though Tehran denies this.

item.title: Nearly 160 migrants rescued while attempting to cross the Channel
item.description: It is one of the largest rescue efforts in the North Sea since migrants began crossing the Channel in 2018.

item.title: Two young hikers struck by lightning in the French Pyrenees
item.description: Two young hikers were struck by lightning during a trek in the French Pyrenees on Monday and taken to hospital, one of them after suffering cardiac arrest.

item.title: Wildfire in Dutch Limburg still not extinguished with 100 hectares burned
item.description: Dutch authorities do not expect the large wildfire in the De Rosmolen nature reserve in northern Limburg to be extinguished before the end of Tuesday morning.

item.title: Crime, terrorism and unrest: US issues travel advisory warning about the dangers of Belgium
item.description: The US State Department has advised Americans travelling to Belgium to "stay aware of [their] surroundings".

item.title: Major wildfire breaks out in Dutch Limburg province
item.description: Dutch rail operator NS has halted train services between Nijmegen and Venray because of the fire.

item.title: Belgian research group issues advice on pregnancies after Ozempic use
item.description: Until now, doctors, midwives and other healthcare professionals had very little guidance on the issue.

item.title: France: 375 people arrested in connection to wildfires
item.description: Out of the 375 people arrested by the French authorities, 142 were minors.

item.title: Iran war: New negotiations to take place on Monday, says Trump
item.description: On Sunday, an Iranian parliament member indicated that efforts were underway to revive negotiations with the US.

item.title: Two new large fires break out in Spain
item.description: This year’s weather conditions have been especially favourable for fires.

item.title: World's biggest oil producers to try increasing production to stabilise prices
item.description: Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Algeria, Kazakhstan and Oman will increase their September production target by about 188,000 barrels a day.

item.title: Why Cambodia built a statue to a Belgian-trained rat
item.description: Standing 2.2 metres tall in the Cambodian city of Siem Reap, the newly unveiled statue of Magawa is perhaps the most unusual war memorial in the world.

item.title: US ravaged by wildfires too as Washington State declares emergency
item.description: Washington is now enduring its fourth consecutive year of drought, the longest such stretch on record for the region.

item.title: Greece: wildfires spread northwest of Athens, threatening historic town
item.description: Overnight from Saturday to Sunday, several hundred firefighters were deployed to tackle the blaze, supported by volunteers and military vehicles.

item.title: Hungary shuts down its nuclear plant due to heat wave
item.description: Hungary’s only nuclear power plant was fully shut down early on Sunday for the first time in 44 years because water levels in the Danube had fallen too low.

item.title: American actor Vincent Pastore known for role in 'The Sopranos' dies at age 80
item.description: According to entertainment outlet Deadline, Pastore was found dead on Saturday at his home in the Bronx.

item.title: Swedish actor confronts antigypsyism in autobiographical performance
item.description: “It’s important that each group has its own voice and that everyone gets to tell their own story.”

item.title: One of world's best mountaineers Nirmal Purja dies in Pakistani avalanche
item.description: British-Nepalese climber Nirmal Purja has died in an avalanche on Broad Peak in Pakistan, his company Elite Expedition has confirmed.

item.title: Chinese carries out military exercises near reef disputed with Philippines
item.description: Beijing and Manila both claim sovereignty over the resource-rich coral atoll, which is controlled by China.
